summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation filed a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing full repayment of US$105 million in private debt ahead of maturity. The retirement covers US$60 million of 5.31% Series B senior notes due September 22, 2027, under a 2017 note purchase agreement, and US$45 million of 5.85% Tranche B loans due May 31, 2028, under a 2018 term loan. Vesta paid accrued interest and applicable make-whole amounts; both agreements terminated. CFO Juan Sottil framed it as balance-sheet discipline ahead of Route 2030. Not a special situation; watch deleveraging and ratings.
